articleTitle: Research on switch address lookup table based on TCAM
abstract: Address table lookup algorithms based on TCAM can accomplish the fixed in one clock cycle prefix match, can achieve rapid switch table lookup and packet forwarding. But the switch of address table update process is a complex process which become the bottleneck of TCAM switch technology development. According to the distribution characteristics of different prefix length table entries and the update rule, when the address table steady-state optimization switches item table space allocation, and introduces the thought of the buffer pool, puts forward an improved switch table update method, so as to improve the efficiency of switch table updates. And on the FPGA hardware implementation and simulation.

articleTitle: An Android-based approach for automatic unit test
abstract: Unit test is the first stage in the V-Model and the foundation of software test. By means of integrating Android JUnit, a testing tool, into a continuous integration platform named Jenkins, this paper proposes a fully automated unit test approach. The approach can generate a visual test report for Android projects. This achievement can significantly increase the efficiency of multiple unit tests, and thus enable engineers to deliver their software products to the end users as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Research on Monte Carlo localization for three-dimension mobile wireless sensor network
abstract: The position is very important information for wireless sensor network, and the present localization methods are mostly suitable for static sensor networks. The paper presents a three-dimension localization algorithm for mobile node wireless sensor network based on Monte Carlo method named MDBMCL. The main contribution of the paper is that the enhanced Monte Carlo localization algorithm is proposed. The algorithm uses the motor direction to prune the anchor box, and the sample and filter is more efficient. According to the result, the method has better performance than traditional Monte Carlo algorithm and Monte Carlo Boxed method in the node localization accuracy and arithmetic speed, and it can provide availability and exact location data for wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Research on parameters optimization and simulation of the Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: Parameters optimization are studied to improve the speed of computing in the Ant Colony Algorithm, Preferences unreasonable takes a long time and search is slow. In order to improve search efficiency of the algorithm, Parameter optimization rules are proposed in the Ant Colony Algorithm, The algorithm improves the basic ant colony algorithm in the parameter selection rules of α.β.ρ. and m, by improving, the ant colony effectively avoid falling into local optimum, speed up the convergence and improve the search efficiency. Simulation results show that parameters optimization effectively improve the performance of the algorithm, the works are feasible and beneficial to the application and development of the ant colony algorithm.

articleTitle: Localization algorithm for mobile nodes in wireless sensor networks based on subsection learning of double-layers BP neural network
abstract: The position information of nodes localization is essential in wireless sensor network. The paper presents a localization algorithm for wireless sensor network mobile nodes based on subsection learning of double-layers BP neural network. The study uses the received signal strength at the unknown point and the speed of the unknown point as the input data to locating the mobile node. Results show the method improves the positioning accuracy for wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Adatative PMD compensation using FBMC in optical transmission system
abstract: Optical fiber communication system is the major part of modern long distance communication, the Polarization Mode Dispersion (PMD) is regarded as the key element limiting the capacity and distance of high speed optical transmission. In this paper, we use an approximately method for comparing the tolerance between OFDM and FBMC, we find that FBMC can compensate the first-order PMD adaptively. Through analysis and numerical simulation, we have concluded that FBMC can behave better under the influence of first-order PMD.

articleTitle: Research on multicast routing for deep space networks based on DTN
abstract: Based on PROPHET routing protocol, MRPTPAE is proposed according to the transmission probability and energy information in this paper which is a novel multicast routing protocol. The fact produce by node energy is considered. And the optimal next hop is decided by the weighted average of the EP which is composed by node energy and transmission probability. Meanwhile, the threshold of the packet forwarding time is controlled by an adaptive transmission value. Owning to the node's storage space easily depleted and network congestion is likely to occur, network congestion Strategy is proposed by forwarding the value of the factor by comparing the message to reduce network congestion. Finally, we use NS2 simulation tool to simulate MRPTPAE which shows that MRPTPAE has better performance in node density and node moving fast scene and is suitable for DTN.

articleTitle: A multi-agent predicting method of fleet spare part requirement for fleet condition based maintenance
abstract: To meet the demand for spare part predicting of a typical mission, a multi-agent based fleet spare part predicting method is proposed. The process of fleet spare part replacement is analysed, and the mathematical expression of fleet spare part predicting problem is introduced. Then the process is described as a 3-layer multi-agent model, and the fleet spare part replacing policy and predicting algorithm are proposed based on the model. Finally, a fleet of 8 aircrafts is studied for verification purpose, a mission type with 4 waves continuous dispatched is imaged. The proposed method can not only solve spare part demand, but provide optimal replacement strategies as well.

articleTitle: Accurate location based services by mobile phone actively detected
abstract: Nowadays, there is an explosive growth of commercial market which is based on mobile location service. One of the notable applications of location based service (LBS) is precision marketing which has displayed its attractiveness all over the world. The core of LBS is real-time and precise positioning technology. Positioning by mobile terminals and positioning by base stations are two major solutions. GPS or base station cell numbers are used in mobile terminal positioning. This positioning technology requests users to forward location information actively and an extra fee relating to internet traffic has to been paid. Also, the coverage of this positioning technology is quite limited. Positioning by base stations utilize the signalling analysis platform to acquire the location of users. Low accuracy of positioning and poor real-time performance are two main shortcomings of this positioning technology. The system we design can acquire the equipment information of mobile phones without the perception of the users. Software radio technology and independent devices are used in positioning for better performance. Equipment information and location information is collected in gateway and forwarded to application platform to provide real-time services to users. Wide coverage, high accuracy of positioning and good real-time performance are notable advantages of this system.

articleTitle: Multi-matrix combined public key based on big data system key management scheme
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, Large-scale data is stored in the cloud, and data security and privacy become more and more important. Key management, as an important part of big data security mechanism, faces the problem of scale demand. A multi-matrix combined public key based big data system key management scheme is proposed in this paper. Key matrix is divided into several little matrixes according to the identity of user, which can resist collusion attack. Key distribution, key updating and key agreement is designed thoroughly. Through security analysis and performance analysis, we can conclude that multi-matrix combined public key based big data system key management scheme has many remarkable characteristics such as high efficiency and security.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of improved LEACH routing protocol for pressure sensor based on WSN
abstract: This paper focused on the energy model and algorithm description of LEACH routing protocol. By analyzing inadequate and combining with the actual situation, proposed network model and assumptions for linear structure, the improved protocol-clustering link routing protocol LEACH-P that it based on LEACH and PEGASIS algorithm ideological, described the network model of LEACH-P protocol which is used in the coal face. This protocol first choose cluster head in the wireless sensor networks and make all nodes into clusters.Then it top-down traversals cluster head and finds a link connection which optimizes cluster head election and inter-cluster communication. NS2 simulation show that the improved protocol can extend the network life cycle and have a good real-time.

articleTitle: Energy consumption research of AES encryption algorithm in ZigBee
abstract: This paper applies IAR to simulate the improved AES algorithm and compares with the standard AES algorithm, to demonstrate the fact that improved AES algorithm can not only reduce the code size, but also reduce the overall energy consumption of ZigBee networks.

articleTitle: Improved transmission schemes and scheduling of the downlink CoMP based on static cluster
abstract: As a key technology of the LTE-A, coordinated multiple point transmission (CoMP) plays an important role on reducing the interference and improving users' throughput. Adopting different coordination strategies, the performances vary greatly with respect to system capacity as well as the overheads. In this paper, we mainly study the strategies for downlink CoMP including joint processing/transmission (JP/JT) and scheduling/beamforming(CS/CB) in different scenarios, respectively. First of all, it presents a coordination strategy that a part of users adopt CoMP-JP/JT within a static cluster. To divide users into coordination and noncoordination, an algorithm based on the channel isolation and a utility function that determines the optimal channel isolation threshold are put forward. Furthermore, extra coordination scheme that some cluster edge users adopt CoMP CS/CB is applied, to eliminate the interference from adjacent clusters. The simulation result shows that our coordination scheme outperforms that based on coordination distance for users with low throughput. The utility function well balances the performance and system backhaul overhead.

articleTitle: Time delay estimation algorithm for multipath channel
abstract: Aiming at the time delay estimation (TDE) problem in wireless communication, this paper proposes an improved sliding window time delay estimation algorithm for multipath channel. It estimates multipath time delay by extracting the mutation information of the sliding sum curve. It can effectively reduce the time delay estimation error caused by multipath with a better performance than frontier detection time delay estimation. This algorithm also performs better than the original sliding sum time delay estimation algorithm in multipath channel with additional white Gaussian noise.

articleTitle: The research for establishment of judgment matrices for the fault type of distribution network based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract: In respect of the research on the strategy of fault types diagnostic problem, because of the randomness and uncertainty of the fault sign in the distribution network, and the question of many fault types are hard to judge, putting forward building the hierarchical indices system of fault classification for distribution network fault, and discussing a direct method that judgment matrices of AHP convert to fuzzy judgment matrices. This method could be used to simplify establishment of fuzzy matrices and then fix weight of all kinds of faults of different equipment that may affect entire grid. Adopting the method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to evaluate the fault happened in distribution network, which could do tradeoff analysis for each affected factors, solving the problem of serious distortion or multiple peak values result from many factors then small weight for each factors. In this way, the evaluation criteria will satisfy the practice demand of the project. Thus, the effectiveness of the proposed method in diagnosing fault types of distribution network was verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: A trusted routing protocol based on Bayesian in VANET
abstract: The particularities of the high dynamic, temporary meeting make the trust and cooperation between vehicles more difficult. To solve this problem, by using trust management model of Bayesian and in the light of the three kinds of opportunistic routing forwarding model, this paper puts forward a trusted routing protocol in VANET Based on GeoDTN+Nav routing protocol. The proposed protocol not only improves the security of routing, but also has the lower time complexity. Experimental results and analysis show that the proposed protocol has achieved good performance in the removal ratio of malicious nodes, correct reception ratio of packet and the message payload.

Author Keywords: geographic DTN routing with navigator prediction

articleTitle: Network intrusion detection based on heterogeneous distance
abstract: Separation measure plays a decisive role in the multi-class support vector machine. Combine with Heterogeneity of network connection data, this paper propose improved HTSVM based on heterogeneous distance. Firstly, define the heterogeneous distance; then compute the separation measure according to the heterogeneous distance between each two classes; then compute the sample that should belong to class according to separation measure. Finely, this method is applied to the network intrusion detection. And simulate with KDDCUP1999 dataset. Experiment result show the method can accurately measure the similarity between heterogeneous data and improve the accurate rate of classification accuracy.

articleTitle: ADF4350-based Frequency Modulation transmitter design
abstract: A ADF4350-based crystal Frequency Modulation (FM) transmitter is designed. The paper conducted theoretical analysis of the loop transfer characteristic of the transmitter, verified the feasibility of the crystal frequency modulation scheme. The frequency synthesizer part of the transmitter selected chip ADF4350, analyzed the frequency synthesis principle of the chip and data timing. Finally, the loop characteristics of the whole transmitter is simulated, and the results show that the design scheme can ensure that the system has good stability, also has low phase noise, therefore has a good prospect.

articleTitle: Efficiency analysis of opportunistic routing protocol in wireless multi-hop networks
abstract: Opportunistic routing (OR) is widely regarded as a promising way to improve the transmission reliability in wireless multihop networks. However, additional overheads introduced by OR such as duplicate transmission and collision avoidance overhead degrade the transmission efficiency. In this paper, an analytical model based on open queueing network with markov chains is proposed to evaluate the efficiency. In the analysis, efficiency is expressed by time overhead including the average queue delay and the back off time to transmit. With the knowledge of delivery ratio, the closed form expressions of time overhead could be obtained. In order to validate rationality of the model, three typical ORs were analyzed based on the proposed model and at the same time a large number of simulation studies have been done. We observed that theoretical value of the proposed model coincides basically with the experimental data with the average error less than 5%.

Author Keywords: Open Queueing Network with Markov Chains

articleTitle: Adaptive time delay estimation for sinusoidal signal based on Recursive Gauss-Newton algorithm
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of estimating the propagation delay between two noisy sinusoid signals with the same known frequency and amplitude. Recursive Gauss-Newton (RGN) algorithm is introduced to solve the time delay estimation model given in [1], rather than LMS. The proposed algorithm is termed RGNADES, which combines the convergence rate advantages of RGN and filtering advantages of ADES. Simulation results show that the proposed methods greatly improve the convergence rate as well as stability in traditional ADES using LMS method.

articleTitle: Horror video recognition based on fuzzy evolution
abstract: Fuzzy evolution model is implemented to resolve horror video recognition problem in this paper. Low-level video features include video key-light, video color energy and video rhythm are extracted as typical features. Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is adopted to estimate the weights of extracted features in fuzzy evolution model. Membership function is constructed for horror detection. The experiments results show that the proposed approach has a high precision, high recall rate and F1 measure, and this indicates the availability of our proposed method.

articleTitle: The relationship between bit-per-pixel, resolution and video quality based on H.264
abstract: In this paper we study the relationship between bit-per-pixel (bit/pixel), resolution and video quality based on H.264. First, we choose 4 most representative 1920x1080 progressive sequences depending on the TI and SI of them. Then, we process these sequences into 5 kinds of resolution and encode these sequences to 6 kinds of bit-per-pixel. Next we calculate SSIM between damaged sequence and original sequence. Finally, according to the relationship between SSIM and MOS, we propose a model that reflects the relationship between bit-per-pixel, resolution, and video quality. The model in this paper shows that when the resolution is unchanged, video quality rises as BPP increased; when the BPP is unchanged, video quality rises as the resolution increased.

articleTitle: A novel inter-satellite routing protocol based on link recognizing
abstract: To resolve the networking problem in the satellite constellation with lots of broken-down nodes, and intermittent connected links, we propose a novel inter-satellite routing protocol based on link recognizing (LRSR). In LRSR, each satellite provides data relaying service for other satellites by the way of DTN,that is, “store-carry-forward”. The main idea of LRSR is: (1) each satellite monitors the state of its links in real time and sends the newest link state changes to all satellites it meets. (2) Receiving link state information, each satellite updates its link state database. (3) While sending out packets, each satellite needs use Dijkstra algorithm and its link state database compute the shortest path and the best next hop, and then deliver packets to next hop node while meeting. The simulation results show that: LRSR routing algorithm has good performance. Using it, the values of packet dropping rate and the values of average network delay are always in a lower level relatively.

articleTitle: The research of multimedia data access model and teaching efficiency
abstract: Multimedia teaching is education reform needs, but it is also teaching development. In recent years, colleges and universities have launched a multi-media teaching, which has been done many studies and has been achieved some results. But there are some problems, school administrators and teachers are only to focus on the individual development of multimedia teaching, who are ignoring the multimedia technology as a whole to promote the development of education. The quality of multimedia are determined by multimedia data access model, which will determine the effectiveness of teaching. In this paper, which is by building multimedia data access model to improve the overall efficiency and effectiveness of multimedia teaching.

articleTitle: Research and optimization on spectrum allocation in two-tier femtocell networks
abstract: In this paper, we will from frequency reuse point of view, an improved algorithm of spectrum allocation and spectrum allocation algorithm is proposed based on literature [1], consider the soft frequency reuse (Soft Frequency Reuse, SFR) applied to the spectrum allocation Acer station, assign a different power to the inside region and outside region macro cell, put forward a kind of improved spectrum allocation methods home base station accordingly, under the premise of ensuring the system performance under the macro users, reduce CO channel between macro cell and between macrocell and family interference and increase system capacity.

articleTitle: PSO-based proactive routing in Delay Tolerant Network
abstract: Delay Tolerant Network (DTN) is a new wireless networking architecture. Although it is designed for the environment where network partitions frequently appear, how to realize the routing algorithm in DTN is still an open question until now. In this paper, we propose a novel proactive routing protocol based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to support the data exchange between isolated nodes. The simulation results show that: our scheme could effectively reduce the network latency and could provide better flexibility and extensibility.

articleTitle: The research of clock synchronization model based on quantum wavelet beacon for cooperative localization
abstract: In this paper, a clock synchronization model based on quantum wavelet beacon is proposed. A timeline and beacon reference point model is presented, to establish synchronous beacon reference point in the base station channel. When the synchronous signal is decomposed by the quantum wavelet transform in the receiving end, the beacon signal of clock synchronization is detected, so the extract precise carrier phase information could be calculated. By this way, the synchronization precision of the communication system is enhanced. Finally, the simulation results of the clock synchronization model based on quantum wavelet beacon are, clock synchronization detection probability is 98.15%, and the clock synchronization precision is 4.579ns. The Matlab simulation verified that the clock synchronization model based on quantum wavelet beacon is reliable and feasible.

articleTitle: Multi_larder service rate congestion control scheme based on QoS in LEO network
abstract: The performance of traditional congestion control strategy is not very well. We create a multi_larder service rate congestion control (MSRCC) system to improve the adaptability in different network condition. The system has multi_larder service rate to adapt various necessary. In the LEO network, it can improve the throughput ability. And the simulation shows the MSRCC scheme has a better work ability.

articleTitle: Study on data mining applications in function calling path testing
abstract: Function calling path (FCP) testing method effectively avoids the problem of the exponential explosion of paths in base path testing, and FCP is now a hot spot in software testing. Introduction of data mining (DM) techniques provides an important opportunity for the realization of knowledge intelligent path testing. This paper systematically introduces, summarizes and comparatively analyses the applications of data mining in several key issues of software testing based on FCP, such as mining software specifications, test case generation, software faults location and forecasting, software version change. This paper also puts forward some further research directions.

articleTitle: An image segmentation method based on gray stretch in wavelet domain
abstract: In this paper, an automatic wavelet domain-based image segmentation method that combines the discrete wavelet transform with the principle of the largest between-class variance is proposed. It not only takes into full account the spatial distribution and contextual relationship between the foreground and background pixels, but also enhances the image contrast and edges, contributing to better target segmentation effect. Experimental comparisons between the proposed method and Otsu's method show that the proposed approach can better suppress interference and extract the target.

articleTitle: The research of context-aware conflict based on SPA
abstract: Context-aware plays a key role in the wisdom network information processing. Due to limited resources, context conflict is inevitable in context-aware. User satisfaction is a good reflection for the wisdom degree of the network. In this paper, through considering the user satisfaction, we propose a novel context-aware conflict solution model based on SPA(set pair Analysis). The model obtain the best server mode by the maximum satisfaction connection degree to solve the conflict in context-aware. The simulation analysis show that the proposed method is simple, effective and can solve many users compete for the same scene of conflict.

articleTitle: Research and realization of multi-channel multi-interface wireless network coding based on guesswork
abstract: COPE, presented by Katti et al. (Proc. ACM SIGCOMM 2006, pp. 243-254), exploits the broadcast nature of the wireless medium through opportunistic network coding. In this paper, we introduce the basic knowledge and characteristic of COPE, and propose a multi-channel multiinterface wireless network coding algorithm based on guesswork (GUESS-MCMI-COPE). By reducing the space of reception reports and implementing multi-channel multiinterface, GUESS-MCMI-COPE can increase network throughput. We evaluate our design on NS2, and discuss the results. The results show that the performance of GUESSMCMI-COPE is superior to that of COPE.

articleTitle: Estimation of spectrum handoff duration in jamming cognitive radio
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) is now playing an increasingly important role in information warfare because of its special abilities of cognition and reconfiguration. To jam CR signals more effectively and smartly, we need to get one of the key parameters-spectrum handoff duration. Spectrum handoff occurs usually when the primary users return in the licensed band or the CR user suffers a certain degree of interference. In this paper, we firstly propose a basic scheme to estimate spectrum handoff duration of CR user, of which the steps include coarse detection (broadband spectrum detection) and fine detection (the time-frequency of specified channels). Then, we propose the corresponding algorithms of the two steps, and perform simulation experiments. The simulation results show that the proposed method can accurately estimate the spectrum handoff duration and is easy for implementation.

articleTitle: Key issues of security in space-based information network review
abstract: This paper concludes and analyses in detail the current key issues of security in space-based information network, concluding handoff security, transmission control security, key management and security routing protocol. In this paper, we summarize current status of these above key techniques, and analyze the main characteristics and important trends of their development.

articleTitle: Energy-saving cooperative spectrum sensing based on dynamic threshold and credibility
abstract: The cooperative spectrum sensing (CSS) needs to transmit more information compared to the single-user spectrum sensing. So registers are adopted in the scheme to reduce the redundant information .Due to the nonuniform feature of geography distribution of cognitive radio (CR) users in the cognitive network, the environment of each CR user is different, which results in different levels of detection credibility of each user. A method based on the combination of dynamic threshold, dynamic credibility and the utilization of false information will be adopted to improve the whole detection probability of CSS. The algorithm is easy to understand and costs less. Under the condition of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) unevenly distributed, the simulation results by MATLAB show that proposed scheme can obtain higher detection performance and less communication overhead compared to the traditional method and approaches in other papers.

articleTitle: Analysis of load balance for leach in wireless sensors networks
abstract: How to extend the lifetime of the Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a hot issue to be researched since the sensor node's energy is limited. LEACH is a famous clustering algorithm to balance the node energy consumption in WSN. The distributions of the energy consumption for various scenarios in LEACH are analyzed in this paper. And the main reasons are found that leading to the asymmetry of the energy consumption among nodes. According to the characteristics of energy consumption, we presented an improved LEACH, which can effectively balance each node's load and improve the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Realization and application on high Q and single passband tunable microwave photonic filter
abstract: A novel structure of microwave photonic filter (MPF) is proposed based on the phase-shifted fiber Bragg grating (PS-FBG). It can realize single pass band scheme. And if we add an optical fiber delay line, we can realize high Q performance by adjusting the reflectivity of two FBGs. We can also achieve tunability by adjusting the optical carrier frequency.

articleTitle: Study on Interplex multiplexing of GNSS signal
abstract: In order to satisfy sending multi-channel navigation signals in one frequency for modern GNSS(Global Navigation Satellite System), the principle of Interplex multiplexing were introduced. And the three-way multiplexing structure and the four-way multiplexing method were also optimized. The power configuration of the multiplexing efficiency and the minimum of the multiplexing efficiency were obtained.

articleTitle: The application of CCA technology in simulation of geophysical applications
abstract: Modeling and simulation of large-scale scientific application is extremely large and complex, such as the Earth system modeling and simulation, seismic simulation, and combustion simulation. It not only needs the support of high-performance computing platform, but also needs a software technology to solve the complexities, and to enhance its flexibility and scalability. CBSE (component-based software engineering) technology is a good solution. But the existing widely used component technology in enterprise applications, such as CORBA/CCM, COM/COM+, J2EE/EJB, and .NET, does not suitable for largescale scientific computing field. The U.S. Department of Energy in conjunction with the Indiana University and the University of Utah recently proposed a component technology CCA (Common Component Architecture) for large-scale scientific computing field. This paper first analyzes CCA and verifies it's feasibility, and then introduces the CBSE into large-scale Geophysical applications using CCA, so as to solve the complexity of modeling, simulation, management and maintenance of the simulation of Geophysical Applications.

articleTitle: Grey clustering comprehensive evaluation model for basin initial water rights allocation schemes
abstract: On the basis of the pre-research of the comprehensive evaluation of basin initial water right allocation scheme, in view of the complexity and differences of the allocation scheme, taking advantages of the grey system clustering evaluation method based on the reformative triangular whitenization weight function, and the method of Analytic Hierarchy Process in historical data processing and sophisticated data integration, integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process and the grey evaluation method of triangle whitening function, this paper conduct grey clustering comprehensive evaluation model based on the center-point triangular whitenization weight function for evaluating basin initial water rights allocation scheme. Finally, we take comprehensive evaluation of basin initial water rights allocation scheme of Tianjin city for instance to demonstrate the feasibility and validity of this model.

articleTitle: Physical layer network-coded MAC strategy
abstract: This paper introduces physical layer network coding into multiple access system and then proposes a physical layer network coded MAC strategy (PNC-MAC). The detail steps of the PNC-MAC are presented. To show the performance of the algorithm, we compare the throughput and average delay induced by the new algorithm with that by modified ALOHA strategy and tree algorithm via simulations. The results showed that when operated with our proposed PNC-MAC, multiple access system can achieve a larger throughput while the frames bear shorter average delay. Besides, in many users case, the throughput increases slightly while the average delay ascends drastically.

articleTitle: Analyzing the time-limited behavior of mobile devices carriers
abstract: In general cases, wireless devices in the cyber world are representatives of their carriers in the physical world. The networking applications performance highly depends on the mobility characteristics of devices carriers. Recently, it has pointed out that the non-Poisson statistics with heavy tail existed in many studies of dynamics of devices carriers. But most of these studies claim that power-law characterizes diverse aspects of devices carriers' mobility patterns. In this paper, we analyze the behavior of library visitation which is obtained from Radio Frequency Identification tags and find that the time interval of entering to the library is well fitted with three sections of lines instead of the traditional distribution. At the same time, we divide the data into groups and extract period bursty events. Through careful analysis in different groups, we draw a conclusion that the aggregate behavior is composed of "heterogeneous groups".

articleTitle: Analyse the urban freight volume of Beijing based on consumption structure
abstract: The change of urban freight volume has a great effect on city road planning and design. Analyse the urban freight transport volume and the corresponding population of vehicle has great significance for urban planning and making policy. Urban freight volume is affected by many related factors like: population, traffic infrastructure, cultural level, etc. This paper from the view of consumption structure, analyse the changes of urban freight volume by regional consumption and industrial characteristics. Build two different mathematical models based on the history data of urban road freight volume and the consumption data in Beijing. Using statistical software SPSS environment, build polynomial regression model and multivariate linear regression models to analyse the urban road freight volume and the number of freight vehicles in Beijing.

articleTitle: Study on the detection of the interference temperature for primary user
abstract: Opportunistic spectrum access (OSA) is a key technique enabling the secondary users (SUs) in a cognitive radio (CR) network to transmit over the “spectrum holes” unoccupied by the primary users (PUs). In contrast to OSA, with spectrum sharing (SS) is allowed to transmit regardless of the PU's on/off status, provided that the resulting interference to PU is kept below a predefined threshold. In this paper, we focus on the maximum interference temperature of the primary users for secondary users' spectrum access in spectrum sharing, which aims to get the minimum signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the PUs as quickly and precisely as possible. We propose a dichotomy algorithm with lower complexity and higher speed in contrast to the traditional full search algorithm. Numerous simulation results are provided to validate the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Secure data sharing between domains in Xen
abstract: Currently Xen has not provided a secure and efficient communication mechanism for data transmission between virtual machines which are deployed on the same physical platform. In this paper, we proposes a secure inter-domain communication mechanism for the different domains on the same physical platform in Xen virtualization environment, and implements a prototype system. Experiments show that the prototype system can prevent the other distrust domain, including privileged domain, through the virtual machine introspection method accessing to the communication information, and it is more efficient than the traditional network transmission.

articleTitle: A routing cooperative selection method based on ant colony optimization algorithm
abstract: Cooperative routing selection algorithm is based on the limited bandwidth and collaborative remain energy, according to pheromone concentration in Ant colony optimization algorithm. The ant colony optimization algorithm is applied to improving collaboration network routing problems to reduce network congestion and reduce node energy consumption. Simulation demonstrate that the algorithm obtains a global optimization and makes an average 60% reduction in end to end delay, increased the utilization of network resources.

articleTitle: Face recognition based on fusion of multilevel centre-symmetric local derivative pattern
abstract: In order to extract richer face texture feature, multi-level centre-symmetric local derivative pattern (CS-LDP) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, CS-LDP is utilized to extract the first level features from the original face image; Secondly, features are extracted from the processed image by the former step using CS-LDP again; lastly, we can get multi-level texture features. The multi-level features can be fused into a whole feature vectors. Experimental results on the ORL and Yaleb faces databases demonstrate that the algorithm of fusing the multi-level CS-LDP features can improve the face recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: A cognitive radio network spectrum balanced allocation algorithm combined spectrum sensing and priority
abstract: This article based on OFDMA cognitive radio networks and spectrum allocation issues, In the overlay spectrum sharing (Spectrum Underlay) way, Research the downstream of a single cellular network cognitive radio spectrum resources allocated. We proposed allocation algorithm by jointly considering the cognitive user priority and sub-set with availability the sub-carrier band equalizer, meanwhile based on the lowest transmission needs of cognitive users to achieve a fair distribution of the sub-carrier band between cognitive user. To make better use of spectrum resources.

articleTitle: Lunar soft landing trajectory optimization methods
abstract: A mathematical model of optimal lunar soft landing problem is given and several common lunar soft landing trajectory optimization methods based on minimum fuel consumption, including Minimum Principle, Ant Colony Optimization method, Genetic Algorithm and Gauss Pseudospectral method are summarized. Solving steps of different methods are discussed and compared. All optimization methods can meet the constraint requirements and accuracy requirements of lunar soft landing trajectory optimal problem. Simultaneously, different optimization methods has different advantages in solving the problem.

articleTitle: Multi-scale feature learning for dynamic scene classification
abstract: In this paper, contrary to most existing hand-crafted descriptor, we propose an automatic feature learning method to solve the problem of dynamic natural scenes classification. Our model use convolutional Restricted Boltzmann machine as building block, called Temporal-Spatial Deep Belief Network (TS-DBN). We train the model over both fine-scale and coarse-scale, which automatically selected from the scale space according to the related information theory knowledge, to learn multi-scale features from each video sequence. The results on Maryland dataset show that feature representation based on automatic deep feature learning methods can achieve comparable accuracy with hand-crafted descriptors. Simultaneously, both coarse and fine-scale features can get better accuracy as compared to single scale features.

articleTitle: Low computational complexity of resource allocation for the MIMO-OFDMA system
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the resource allocation of the multi-input multi-output and orthogonal frequency division multiple access (MIMO-OFDMA) system when SNR is high, including subcarrier allocation and power allocation. Previous researchers mainly concentrate on increasing the system's capacity, but they don't care about the computational cost for using the optimal solutions. In this paper, we propose a new method to reduce the computational complexity. At first, we combine with the subcarrier chunk scheduling and a mathematical simplification criterion to alleviate the complexity of subcarrier allocation. Then we use a modified iterative water-filling to decrease the computational complexity of the power allocation. In order to limit the minimum and maximum resources allocated to the users, fairness constraint is employed. Simulation results show that our algorithm can achieve very close system capacity performance of the optimal performance in the MIMO-OFDMA system. It can also be seen from the results that our algorithm can work very well in user fairness.

articleTitle: A study of quickly customized web service techniques based on Simple Cone Search Protocol
abstract: Quickly customized web service construction technology is a key in the astronomical data processing, it is a connection between the data source and the astronomers. In view of the current IVOA framework and web service implementation are too complex, astronomers cannot quickly master them. Astronomical web service construction template by simple customization can realize fast simplified construction to meet the needs of the construction of virtual observatory. Simple Cone Search Protocol (SCS) provides an interface for searching catalogs by sky position. In this paper, we have a study on the quickly customized web service construction technology by using software engineering theory and code generation technology, and discuss the critical techniques of the system implementation. Finally, we present a system for fast data publishing, which named C-FDP, to realize the automatic customized query based on SCS. C-FDP packages for the current astronomical service construction technical details, and gets out the web service construction template which can meet the need of data publishing in the greatest degree.

articleTitle: A novel video based face detection algorithm
abstract: A novel approach for face detection in video is proposed. Vision Similarity is defined to measure the relationship between video frames. Then the candidate face regions are obtained in previous video frame, which has similarity with the current frame. The local Successive Mean Quantization Transform (SMQT) and Sparse Network of Winnows (SNoW) are used on candidate regions, and the skin color segmentation is implemented for non-vision similar frames. Experimental results show that, with the candidate region, the detection algorithm has better performance on real-time procession than the previous one. And the detection accuracy is also higher than it as well.

articleTitle: No reference estimation of the coding PSNR for 4K-UHD videos
abstract: With the wide-spread use of digital videos, quality considerations have become essential, and industry demand for video quality measurement standards is rising. In this paper, we proposed a no reference estimation of the coding PSNR for 4K-UHD videos in the compressed domain. As video coding parameters which can reflect the degree of distortion caused by compression can be extracted in compressed domain, we firstly extracted some feature parameters from 4k-UHD compressed videos. Then the parameters were applied to train the proposed model with the corresponding PSNR using multi-linear algorithm. After the training process, estimated PSNR can be acquired using the trained model. The experimental results show that our model can achieve a good performance for the 4K-UHD video streams with the corresponding PSNR.

articleTitle: A Distributed 3D scene modeling framework based on three-layer ontology
abstract: Nowadays, the traditional single computer design system has been challenged and there is an increasing demand of building complex scene modeling of 3D models. With the more and more field are involved in the process of 3D scene modeling the design of 3D scene require both domain experts and 3D scene modeler. In this paper, A Framework DMSCRF (Distributed 3D Model Semantic Characteristic Retrieve Framework ) based on three-layer ontology is proposed to help distributed 3D scene modeler to retrieve domain knowledge, which is build by domain experts, in the process of scene modeling. By analyzing the semantic constraints among the models in the specific 3D model scene, the proposed ontology with good scalability consists of three layers: the general ontology for the features of the model, the domain ontology for a model of specific scene and the scene ontology for semantic of an certain 3D model scene. As the scene ontology is distributed stored, the paper also design the procedure of retrieve and validate semantic constraints based three-layer ontology in a distributed environment. The result shows the framework has good scalability and supports collaborative work.

articleTitle: A platform for GSM Um interface signaling observation
abstract: The paper designs a platform which is used for observing signaling messages. The platform can be applied in many fields, such as cellphone security, signaling teaching, malicious attack and so on. In this paper, we mainly introduce its effects in signaling teaching. A distributed GSM teaching platform is designed, which is used for helping students to study GSM Um interface protocols better. Cooperating with a client, students can clearly observe the signaling interaction process of Um interface between a mobile and GSM cellular networks and check the original and the parsed data. Below, the distributed structure of the platform are detailed introduced, and then implementations are introduced from three parts including the client, the server and the base station. Finally, the effectiveness of the platform is demonstrated through an operation instance, verifying the effectiveness of the platform.

articleTitle: The implementation of a live interactive augmented reality game creative system
abstract: Interaction is the most important factor that may much influence gaming experience. Given that Augmented Reality presentations enable the more creation ways of user interactions that expand traditional HCI from 2D to 3D spaces, this offer an ideal opportunity for game developers to design more playful and interesting AR games that embed various interaction forms. In this paper, we build an augmented reality game creative platform, which allows game developers to integrate augmented reality features,spatial human computer interaction mechanism and other advanced interaction techniques into the designed game.In this system, we implement a adopted augmented reality function to help the developers to directly superimpose the visual 3d objects over the live real video image and then port human motion interactive trigger module to this system based on kinect, in which a up-down hierarchy figure description algorithm is proposed to build a common virtual 3d human model prototype that could allow developer ignore the difference of various players' shape and make the players easily to use their actions to interact with the 3d virtual objects to get more unique game experience.

articleTitle: HNSARA: A history-and-node-state-based active routing algorithm for DTN
abstract: The routing algorithm of the DTN, which experience frequent long-duration partitions, is quite different from the normal networks. Active routing algorithms usually adopt an active host (data mule/message ferry) to exchange and forward the messages. In the existing studies in DTN, the active routing problem is generally solved by adopting the solutions of the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP). In such solutions, the active routing problem is often solved by finding a simple cycle with no repeated nodes nor edges. By considering a more general scenario, we propose an active routing algorithm, which is based on the historical information and node states, where the route is a closed walk. The simulations verify the accuracy and efficiency of the active routing algorithm we proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A risk assessment method of cloud computing based on multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract: The application of cloud computing brings not only enormous economic benefits but also security risks. According to the safety risk problems faced by cloud computing environment, this paper on the basis of the experience of traditional risk analysis methods, qualitatively researches the main factors of cloud computing risk, and adopts multi-level fuzzy evaluation method to analyze multiple decision objectives, which is combined with Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method and fuzzy evaluation theory; Then using this method to construct a model and give an example of calculation in cloud computing, the result of this example shows that the risk assessment method used in this paper is effective, and it has a certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Optical Switching Technology in the all optical communication
abstract: Two major component part of the communication network is the transmission and switching, with the demand of capacity of communication and the development of light communication. Because of the limitation of electronic transfer rate becomes the bottleneck of communication in the electrical. Therefore the key technology of all optical communication network was put forward ----Optical Switching Technology. At firstly, the conception, characteristics and classification of the optical switching technology are introduced in this paper. At last, in the paper introduces the development of Optical-Switching-Technology.

articleTitle: An attack-aware routing algorithm based on immune artificial fish swarm optimization in optical networks
abstract: For multicast security routing in optical network, through the adoption of maximum light path attack radius MaxLAR criterion, Combined with the advantages of the immune algorithm and artificial fish algorithm, this paper proposes a new attack-aware routing algorithm based on immune artificial fish swarm optimization in optical networks. The algorithm can find out the smallest light path attack radius in light paths under the given condition, can enhance the capacity of optical network attack prevention, can reduce the light damage by the potential physical-layer attacks. Through algorithm analysis, we can show that the algorithm is feasible, and have achieved good performance.

articleTitle: A constellation design based on direct insertion and decoding algorithm for noncoherent unitary space-time codes
abstract: A novel scheme of unitary space-time constellations generation based on zero vectors adding are proposed for the multiple-antenna communication system. In the scheme, T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> zero row vectors are added into conventional unitary matrices directly, and the number of new unitary matrices obtained by different positions of the added zero vectors in T symbol duration is ⌊T/T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>|⌋ times larger than that of conventional unitary matrices. According to the special construction, a corresponding decoding algorithm is proposed with low complexity in flat fading channel. Simulation results show that the proposed the constellation outperform the conventional constellations and the proposed decoding algorithm is efficient and simple.

articleTitle: Microdisk resonator sensor based on negative permeability metamaterials
abstract: A novel microdisk resonator sensor based on negative permeability metamaterials. The dispersion relationship of the cyllindrical waveguide coated with single negative metamaterials is obtained, and the resonant frequency and Q factor working at whisper-gallery-mode (WGM) is computed using finite element method (FEM), and agreement between theoretical results and simulation results is demonstrated to be good. Results show that the sensitivity of the sensor is significantly enhanced by the negative permeability metamaterials, and the Q factor can be tailored by adjusting the distance between the waveguide and the microdisk.

articleTitle: Clustering algorithm based on optimal number of clusters for wireless multimedia sensor networks
abstract: In the design of routing algorithm for wireless multimedia sensor networks, aiming at how to meet QoS requirements as well as to improve the energy efficiency, an efficient Optimal Number of Clusters Algorithm (ONCA) was proposed. ONCA divides network region into uneven virtual grids based on the optimal number of clusters. ONCA selects and prioritizes the cluster-head and forwarding candidate set in an efficient manner, which considers the remaining energy of nodes. In the stage of data transmission, packets transmission rate can be optimized dynamically. Simulation results show that ONCA meets the requirement of QoS in real-time and reliability domains and can extend the network life cycle.

articleTitle: The application of fountain code in differential frequency hopping systems
abstract: Based on the anti-jamming performance of differential frequency hopping (DFH) systems in Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel, Fountain code is introduced to the DFH systems as the outer error correcting code in this paper to investigate the improvements against partial-band jamming over AWGN channel. The performance of Fountain coded DFH is theoretically analyzed and numerically simulated. The total frequencies of hopping in the simulation is 16, and results show that, on one hand, when exact jamming state information (JSI) is available, and the number of jamming frequency is n=16, the bit error rate (BER) of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> is achieved with the signal to interference ratio (SIR) approximately 7.5 dB over AWGN channel, and the performance improves about 1-1.5dB compared with the no-coded system. When the number of jamming frequency is n=2, the performance increases 15-17dB. The anti-jamming performance of Fountain coded DFH systems is obviously superior to no-coded DFH systems.

articleTitle: Low-overhead cooperative spectrum sensing technology for cognitive radio networks
abstract: In the past few years,the cooperative sensing in cognitive radio networks (CRNs) has attracted considerable attention because of its high reliability. But a large number of cooperative users produce a huge overhead in the reporting process. In this paper, we propose a new scheme to reduce the sensing overhead in CRNs, called low-overhead cooperative sensing scheme (LCS). In this scheme, we only allow those users, which detect the presence of the PU report the sensing results. Then we use a pre-sensing sequential detection technology to decrease the whole sensing time T. Considering the preload sensing slots, we derive a formula to express the overall miss detection probability. In order to minimize the average time of spectrum sensing (AT), we design a rule to protect primary transmissions over the Rayleigh fading channel. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve superiority and efficiency of the LCS scheme. It is also seen from the results that our algorithm can reach the given sensing accuracy for CRNs.

articleTitle: A fast algorithm for impairment-aware dynamic routing and wavelength assignment
abstract: In wavelength-routed optical networks (WRON), the optical signal will pass through various optical devices during the transmission in the optical path. Since there exist no electrical regenerators in WRON, the physical layer damage caused by optical devices will continue to accumulate, which will lead to reduce quality of transmission. In this paper, we propose a fast algorithm for impairment-aware dynamic routing and wavelength assignment (FIRWA), which takes the amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) and four-wave mixing (FWM) into consideration. The contribution of this algorithm is to build a partition database called the partition case base (PCB). The PCB can dynamically save and update the paths. which meet the requirements of the quality of service (QoS). So the proposed algorithm can quickly retrieve the known paths based on the previous information. From the simulation result, we can see that the FIRWA has better performance than the traditional impairment-aware routing and wavelength assignment (IRWA).

articleTitle: Hazard assessment of the debris flow using rough sets and Dempster-Shafer theory
abstract: A debris flow is a common geological hazard which brings loss of tremendous life property. Whether it will occur depends on many impact factors. Hazard assessment of debris flow aims to decide the hazard level of debris flow by analysing some impact factors. It is a critical step for forecasting the occurrence of debris flow disaster. In this paper, we propose a novel method, employing rough sets and Dempster-Shafer theory, to analyse the impact factors of debris flows. We first detailed the procedure, and then the samples of 37 debris flow gullies in Yunnan were utilized to evaluate the method. The result suggests that the method is effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Android malware detection based on permission and behavior analysis
abstract: The development of mobile Internet and application store accelerates the spread of malicious applications on smartphones, especially on Android platform. In this paper, we propose an integrated Android malware detection scheme, combining permission and behavior analysis. For APK files which had been detected, their MD5 values are extracted as signature for detection. For APK files which had not been detected, detection is carried based on permission and behavior analysis. Behavior analysis contained taint propagation analysis and semantic analysis. Experiment results show that this system can detect the malware of privacy stealing and malicious deduction successfully.

articleTitle: A directional opportunistic DTN routing based on utility estimation in cyberspace
abstract: The constant copies were injected into the delay tolerant networks (DTN) initially by Multi-copies routings which got the higher connection probability comparing with traditional flooding method. In order to reduce the influence of the redundancy copies and utility in cyberspace environment, we proposed the scheme with the directional opportunistic routing based on utility estimation (ESOR) to make adaptive forwarding decision with the optimal copies. ESOR used the different network metrics to compute the maximum utility value iteratively and get the optimal numbers of message copies. We impacted the algorithm on the ONE, the results showed that the proposed scheme compared with other controlled flooding routings made a better performance.

articleTitle: An optimized prototype filter for OFDM/OQAM system
abstract: Most of the researches in recent years have been focused on a new multicarrier system OFDM/OQAM, which is different from the traditional OFDM based on cyclic prefix (CP). Using offset QAM modulation, the new system ensures high channel utilization without CP. In the modulated and demodulated process of OFDM/OQAM, the signals must through pulse shaping using prototype filters, so an appropriate filter is particularly important. In this paper, an optimized filter based on Zak transformation is proposed, which has better time-frequency localization (TFL). The experimental simulation proved that new system can resist the effects of multipath fading and Doppler spread effectively, thus having better BER performance.

articleTitle: A parallel target-directed analysis method for malware behaviors
abstract: To improve the efficiency of analyzing malware behaviors and increase the validity of the test data, this paper proposes a parallel target-directed analysis method for malware behaviors, which combines static analysis with concolic testing techniques. It first uses static analysis techniques to identify and locate those interactive or input points and sensitive behavior functions. Then based on the distributed platform, by combining symbolic execution and concrete dynamic execution together and taking malware sensitive behaviors as the leading target, the parallel target-directed algorithm of searching sensitive paths and the method of leading and approaching sensitive behaviors are designed. It leads to traverse the sensitive functions, obtain the sensitive paths which can reach the sensitive behavior areas by path backtracking, and generate the corresponding test data. Finally, it finishes the analysis and test of malware behaviors. Experiments show that, compared with fuzz and full paths covering and traversing technique, this method can generate test data more efficiently, reduce the number of paths to be analyzed, and improve the analysis speed and efficiency of malware behaviors.

articleTitle: Towards dominant resource fairness in virtualized cloud environment
abstract: Fair job-scheduling problem in virtualized cloud computing environments has been a focus of research recently, yet this has not received adequate attention in the context of private cloud, where each physical machine hosts a set of virtual machines, while each of virtual machine supports several tasks running on it. In this paper, we introduce a rigorous definition of dominant resource share of tasks and virtual machines, and design a two stage dominant resource fairness scheme that investigate the problem of optimally utilizing a limited amount of a resource (e.g., CPU, memory, bandwidth, or storage) while maximizing application performance and present the inherent tradeoff between resource utilization and fairness in the job-scheduling process. We design a simple heuristic that implements our model in real-world system. Large-scale simulations driven by traces of our cloud platform show that the proposed job scheduling mechanism significantly improves the cloud system's resource utilization, yet with a substantial reduction of job completion times.

articleTitle: Optimal power control scheme in LTE networks based on utility function
abstract: In this paper, transmission power control problem for uplink LTE network is investigated and a new autonomic uplink power control scheme was proposed based on utility function, which is a self-organized algorithm. The whole approach is based on the economic concept named utility function. The proposed scheme is solved through the Lagrange multiplier technique. It is proved that the utility function based algorithm is applicable and the optimal power level can be achieved based on our model.

articleTitle: Application of Weighted Grey Target theory on informatizational assessment of ports
abstract: According to the incomplete information due to the imperfect index of port informatizational evaluation and instability of the relevant data, the Weighted Grey Target theory is introduced to assess the informatization status of ports. This paper constructed the evaluation index, evaluated the index's attributes combining the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and selected 11 ports to rank order by using the Weighted Grey Target model. It concludes that Port of Shanghai has won the highest score belonging to the assessment Class I area, while Port of Lianyungang, Yantian, Jinzhou, Jiaxing and Wenzhou have got low scores belonging to the assessment Class IV area. The result shows that the Weighted Grey Target theory is a simple and effective method to assess the port informatizational performance.

articleTitle: Non-cooperative differential game based load balancing algorithm in Radio-over-Fibre system
abstract: Load balancing plays a critical role in a cellular network. As one kind of cellular network, Radio-over-Fibre (RoF) system can provide ubiquitous high data-rate transmissions, which has attracted many attentions, but it also suffer load unbalancing problem. In order to improve the system performance, in this paper, we propose a novel loading balance scheme in RoF system based on differential game theory. The scheme formulates the load allocated to each RAP (Radio Access Point) as a Nash Equilibrium, using noncooperative differential game to obtain the optical load allocation of each RAP. The simulations performed show that the non-cooperative differential game algorithm is applicable and the optimal load solution can be achieved.

articleTitle: Study on path loss of ZigBee signal in electrical substation environment
abstract: The performance of wireless communication system is greatly constrained by the characteristics of wireless channel, therefore, the need for wireless channel path loss prediction is becoming more and more urgent. A ground wire monitoring system based on ZigBee is introduced. ZigBee wireless signal path loss measurement is conducted in a substation with strong electromagnetic, and the data is fitted by least-squares method, and finally determine an empirical formula based on logarithmic path loss model. The study provides a theoretical basis for wireless sensor network node layout in substation, which has some promotional value.

articleTitle: A recommend system for modelling large-scale advertising
abstract: In a large-scale network environment, the Internet has produced an amount of digital information such as social media, e-commercial comments, online shopping records and advertising click logs. So, recommend systems not only furnish users with satisfied requirements but also bring about healthy profit to companies. To cope with massive data, we proposed an effective recommend system (ERS) for modelling abundant history data. Firstly, we advise a new data split strategy to make the recommend system fit for large scale advertising. Then, a distributed-recommendation algorithm is designed. Finally, we apply ERS and distributed computing and storage tools (such as Spark, Hadoop, etc.) to model history data aiming at improving the system efficiency. In this paper, we also compare and analyse diverse performances of ERS including its efficiency and its accuracy.

articleTitle: A ontology semantic similarity algorithm between user's context ontology
abstract: This paper considers a context similarity algorithm based on ontology semantic which recommends commodities to users by the similarity between current user's context and source context recorded. First, we divide the context ontology tree into many subtrees with subtree cutting algorithm. According to calculating the similarity of subtrees with the weight sum, we obtain the similarity between the source context and target context. Meanwhile, during calculating the similarity of subtrees, this paper allows for ontology semantic similarity, and adds the structure similarity degree algorithm on the basis of the old ontology similarity degree algorithm, which makes the result more accord with actual, and finally the experiment is verified.

articleTitle: Robust secure transmission for cooperative ARQ based on secrecy rate and outage optimization
abstract: Physical layer security is an emerging technique to improve the wireless communication security and the corresponding techniques under practical scenarios especially with imperfect channel state information (CSI) need to be taken into consideration. In this paper, we investigate the robust secure transmission for cooperative decode-and-forward (DF) automatic-repeat-request (ARQ) in multiple-input-single-output (MISO) relaying wiretap channels with channel estimation errors. Firstly, the robust transmit covariance matrices and the optimal beamforming weights are obtained using the semi-definite relaxation (SDR) approach to maximize the secrecy rate under power constraint and channel uncertainties. Besides, we further propose a robust design scheme from the secrecy outage-based characterizations for minimizing the secrecy outage probability of legitimate destination. Moreover, a non-robust scheme, in which the designed beamformer refers to the generalized eigenvectors of the channels' matrix pencil, is also considered as a benchmark. Simulation results verify the robustness of the proposed schemes against the estimation errors and shows that the robust design schemes can significantly improve the security performance of the network.

articleTitle: The analysis and implementation of AllJoyn based thin client communication system with heartbeat function
abstract: The interconnection of heterogeneous networks becomes a bottleneck in the development of the IoT. The birth of AllJoyn is just to solve this problem. At the same time, embedded devices with a specific function or a small number of functions occupy a large proportion in the IoT, how to achieve interconnection with resource limited devices becomes very important. In this paper, we divide the AllJoyn based IoT devices into two parts, one is AllJoyn Standard Client (AJSC) and the other is AllJoyn Thin Client (AJTC). We will compare AJTC with AJSC in AllJoyn distributed bus, communication flow and their architecture. This paper also points out the problem in AllJoyn thin client communication, and proposes a heartbeat mechanism for devices with online detection. Finally, we achieve the interconnection between AJTC and AJSC in a system prototype.

articleTitle: Wireless ad hoc network system based on IEEE 802.15.4G
abstract: IEEE 802.15.4g is an amendment to IEEE 802.15.4 standard. It is a new PHY layer scheme in order to meet the requirements such as low-power, low-cost and long-distance transmission according to the applications of smart metering utility network. In this paper, we put forward a high effective and low-power wireless ad hoc network system based on IEEE 802.15.4g standard. We design hardware and software and realize collection and monitoring of a variety of environmental parameters. The experiment shows that the system is robust and self-healing. It is suitable in industrial control, environmental monitoring and smart meter measurement.

articleTitle: Power allocation in estimation fusion with phase asynchronization at the fusion center
abstract: We consider power allocation problem in wireless sensor networks with phase synchronization error at the fusion center. The sensors amplify-and-forward their measurements (using uncoded analog transmission) to a remote fusion center over wireless fading channels. The residual phase error at the fusion center is modeled by the Tikhonov distribution. The global optimal power allocation algorithm is proposed. The power allocation problem can be changed into the matrix eigenvector problem. And the closed-form solutions for power amplification coefficients and Linear Minimum Mean Square Error (LMMSE) are obtained. Monte Carlo simulations are carried out to verify the performance of the proposed methods. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme outperforms the optimal scheme without considering phase error and uniform power allocation algorithm.

articleTitle: An efficient method of detecting repackaged android applications
abstract: With the massive popularity of smartphones, many third-party marketplaces are emerged to meet smartphone users' need. These third-party marketplaces usually provide thousands of applications, but can't guarantee their security. Among the malicious applications, repackaging is one of the most common techniques to piggyback malicious payloads into legitimate applications. In order to keep the android ecosystem healthy, an app similarity measurement system is proposed to detect repackaged applications directly from the DEX file. We use the string length as the fingerprint to measure the similarity between third-party application and the original one, afterwards according to the similarity score whether one third-party application is repackaged or not can be determined. We perform a systematic study on five popular Android-based third-party marketplaces with randomly 200 samples from each third-party marketplace. Further manual investigation shows that these repackaged apps are mainly used to replace existing in-app advertisements or embed new ones to “steal” or re-route ad revenues. We also identify a few cases with planted malicious payloads among repackaged apps.

articleTitle: Kernel sparse representation for object tracking
abstract: Object tracking is a challenging problem to develop an effective model, which can handle appearance change caused by illumination change, occlusion, and motion blur. In this paper, we propose an online tracking algorithm with kernel sparse representation, local image patches of a target are represented by their sparse codes schemes with an over-complete dictionary, and online classifier is learned to discriminate the target. To improve robustness of the algorithm and the performance of the classifier, kernel function is applied on the sparse representation. In addition to, we propose a simple yet effective method for dictionary update. Experiments on challenging image sequences show that the proposed algorithm performs favorably against several state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Improved scaling of spectrum decision mechanism in cognitive radio networks
abstract: In cognitive radio networks,We usually use nine scaling law based on multi-attribute utility theory as a common spectrum decision mechanism.the traditional scale method only consider the spectrum own objective properties and then makes judgments is not comprehensive enough. This paper through researched the mechanism of scaling judgment in psychology, a new and improved scale method were proposed, and the new scale method applied to spectrum decisions of cognitive radio networks, So that the measure of subjective judgment factors are more scientific and makes more explicit determination in spectrum decisions. Finally,we through simulation to verify the superiority of the improved scaling.

articleTitle: Intrusion tolerance system against denial of service attacks in wireless sensor network
abstract: Disruption of service caused by denial of services (DoS) attacks is an increasing problem in the Internet world and it is also a serious problem in wireless sensor network (WSN). Due to the limited resources and node energy in WSN platforms, we must tailor the security mechanisms based on the characteristics of WSN. We present a analysis on classification on five layers of available mechanisms for DoS defense. These defense mechanisms are used to prevent, detect, response and tolerate the DoS attacks. This paper provides better understanding of the DoS attack problem and enables a security administrator to combat and mitigate the DoS threat.

articleTitle: Research on data security issues of cloud computing
abstract: Data security issue is a key bottleneck restricting the application of cloud computing promoting and applications. In this paper, states of the art of the techniques on cloud computing data security issues, such as data encryption, access control, integrity authentication and other issues is surveyed, on this basis, some important technical issues of the cloud computing data security should concern about and focus on are indicated.

articleTitle: Comparative study of VANET routing protocols
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc network is a fast mobile broadband wireless network, which can provide a variety security applications and business applications of for vehicles such as traffic safety management, accident alarm, auxiliary driving, Internet information services. Routing is one of the key technologies of vehicle network, so this paper studies the VANET routing protocol by using literature comparative study method. The routing protocol based on topology, the routing protocol based on geographic location, the routing protocol based on the cluster, the routing protocol based on opportunity strategy and the routing protocols based on security are compared respectively.

articleTitle: The security analysis of PhpBB forum
abstract: PhpBB forum is one of the widely applied network forums. In this paper, we investigate the security of this kind of forum. We analyze the whole process of security mechanism related to user's password, including password checking in registration, password storage in database and password identification when users log in. Our research indicates that security of the earlier version is weak, and subsequent 3.0 version provides more secure cryptographic algorithm. However, in order to acquire the compatibility, the forum software retains the weak algorithm which brings the potential security threat. According to this vulnerability, we design the corresponding attack while we also propose the countermeasures.

articleTitle: Android's sensitive data leakage detection based on API monitoring
abstract: Due to the openness of Android, more and more malware has exploded, and constitutes a huge security threat to Android-based smartphones. This paper proposes a mechanism to study sensitive data leakage by analyzing sensitive APIs, decompiles Android APK to get smali files, and defines a sensitive API library related to user privacy. Then, analyzes the potential threats by detecting the sensitive API in the source code, and determines whether there is a sensitive data leakage. We analyzed 20 applications with the help of the mechanism, and in the paper we present one detailed analysis process.

articleTitle: A method based on MD5 and time for preventing deception in electronic commerce
abstract: Aiming at reducing the risk of data being intercepted and preventing deceptions in the electronic commerce, this paper proposes a method based on MD5 and time which can effectively prevent the deception in data transmission. The method uses the traditional MD5 algorithm to encrypt and validate important data, then verifying the validity and legitimacy of the data by using time.

articleTitle: Specialized resource repository of ZADL—A case of co-construction and sharing of resources
abstract: In digital information age, rapid progress has been made in the integration of China's digital library resources and in the construction of specialized resources. The project “Zhejiang University Digital Library” (ZADL) has come into being. This paper introduces the overall construction, structure of resources, service system and the system of application. It has also discussed in detail the management institution, architectural model and principles in the construction of the specialized resources database. It has also emphasized that specialized characteristics should be highlighted in the construction of the ZADL Project.

articleTitle: Using Short Message Service (SMS) to deploy Android exploits
